Currently working as a full-time Software Engineer at APETECH Solutions (2+ years of experience). I continuously research and advance my skills through enterprise projects.
intro: Hi! I'm a Full-Stack Developer with 2+ years of full-time experience at APETECH Solutions, specializing in Enterprise ERP Systems such as HRM, FnB, and PMS. Currently, I am also actively researching and building modern ERP solutions.

My core technical stack includes React, Angular, React Native, NestJS, ASP.NET Core, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and MySQL. Alongside enterprise ERP systems, the remaining projects are personal projects that I independently developed.
I prioritize clean code architecture, system performance, and intuitive user experiences while collaborating effectively in an Agile/Scrum environment.
